description: Matryoshka settings of the paper's experiments (Section 7). Keys under 'regression' and 'classification' are Augmenter arguments; corr_threshold null disables pruning.

itw.section: 7.2 End-to-end results (Table 3) and anytime augmentation on ITW Categorical (Fig. 4a)

autofeat.section: 7.2 Anytime augmentation on the AutoFeat lakes (Fig. 4b)
autofeat.downstream: AutoFeat's original ensemble (random forest, gradient boosting, extra trees, XGBoost), reporting mean accuracy

kitana_loo.protocol: Each table with skip=false and a target is the query in turn; it is removed from the index before the query and re-inserted afterwards. disc.csv and datamart.socrata.data-cityofnewyork-us.t5qg-w9sq are dropped, leaving 256 queries.

evaluation.query_preparation: prepare_query_table_paper: drop rows with a missing key or target; mode imputation for categorical and iterative Bayesian Ridge imputation for numeric features; AutoGluon AutoMLPipelineFeatureGenerator (text n-gram and special features off); ordinal-encoded classification target; join key normalised with process_key; binned setup: 4 quantile bins, dummy-coded with the first level dropped
evaluation.augmented_preparation: prepare_augmented_table: values beyond 1e17 masked, iterative imputation with a histogram gradient boosting regressor (100 iterations, depth 3, learning rate 0.1, 10 nearest features, 5 rounds), rows with missing values dropped
